purpose: Add compact, high-authority global macro, trade and semiconductor-policy facts without treating public discovery metadata as professional news.

source_shortlist.retention: headline, short feed summary, category, source URL and timestamps only
source_shortlist.historical_depth_evidence: official press-release archive lists annual collections back through the full713 window and earlier
source_shortlist.pit_rule: Use an explicit feed timestamp when present; otherwise freeze at end of the displayed publication day.
source_shortlist.revision_rule: stable source URL plus immutable content hash; a changed hash becomes a new revision and never overwrites an earlier snapshot

source_shortlist.retention: accession metadata, form type, issuer mapping, filing and acceptance timestamps, source URL; no filing body
source_shortlist.historical_depth_evidence: official submissions history and static daily or quarterly archives cover the full713 window
source_shortlist.pit_rule: Use documented EDGAR dissemination or acceptance time; locally captured first_seen_at remains separate.
source_shortlist.revision_rule: accession number is immutable; amendments and corrected filings remain separate linked revisions
source_shortlist.request_policy: identified User-Agent, efficient bulk files where appropriate, well below the official 10 requests per second ceiling

source_shortlist.retention: document number, agency, title, abstract, publication date, source URL and compact topic tags
source_shortlist.pit_rule: Use public-inspection time only when explicitly documented; otherwise freeze at end of publication day.
source_shortlist.revision_rule: document number plus content hash; corrections are separately linked official documents

source_shortlist.retention: title, displayed date, compact agency excerpt, category and source URL
source_shortlist.pit_rule: Freeze at end of displayed publication day unless an explicit time is exposed in machine-readable metadata.
source_shortlist.revision_rule: stable URL plus content hash snapshot

source_shortlist.retention: RSS headline, release summary, category, timestamp and source URL
source_shortlist.pit_rule: Use feed timestamp if explicit; otherwise end of displayed publication day.
source_shortlist.revision_rule: stable URL plus content hash snapshot

source_shortlist.retention: document number, title, issuing unit, displayed publication time, effective date, compact policy tags and source URL
source_shortlist.pit_rule: Use the official displayed publication timestamp when present; effective_at is separately recorded and never substitutes for available_at.
source_shortlist.revision_rule: official document number plus content hash; correction or repeal documents remain linked immutable events
